instructions: 1. Say to your AI: "Save what you learned about how this person writes, for one kind of writing", and give it fields.
2. The AI calls run_resource_operation at @workshop-tools with method tools:run, tool tool:save-voice and its input (the worked example shows one).
3. Read what comes back: Saves what you learned from tool:read-voice as the voice profile of one kind of writing (kind, like post or email; leave out for a general one).
4. It reads and writes only its own rows through the records door: voice-profile (records:read, records:list, records:write).
